title: Final Exam
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: A student knew every answer on an n-question multiple-choice exam but recorded each answer one line too early, so the answer to each question landed on the line belonging to the previous question and the final line was left blank. Given the answer key as a sequence of at most one thousand letters, the task is to report how many lines the student still scored.
